summary: Rubico Inc., a Greek-based Nasdaq-listed tanker owner, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the closing of its previously disclosed share purchase agreement dated July 27, 2026, under which it acquired a special-purpose vehicle holding a shipbuilding contract with Guangzhou Shipyard International for a 47,499 dwt chemical/product MR tanker, a related-party transaction with Top Ships Inc. Delivery is scheduled for Q2 2029, and the vessel is fixed on a seven-year time charter to a major oil trader with a four-year extension option. The company also completed its 0.50-for-one stock dividend. No board recommendation or advisor was named; the SPV's build installments are 85% financed and the filing cites roughly $226.3 million of backlog from the three newbuildings. Watch related-party terms, financing overhang, and delivery slippage.
